body.x: PPYPLE(representative Sang-sin Kim www.pplple.com) is introducing docking station 'Swing ball i' supporting view from varied angles by turning at CES 2012(Consumer Electronics Show 2012) held in Las Vegas, US from Jan 10 to 13 (local time).

Docking station 'Swing Ball i' supports view from varied angles by rotating front part. With rotation front part, it offers optimal view. User can enjoy their cellphone in varied environment such as on the desk, sofa, bed, and others.

In particular, famous designer group Ugly duckling participated in design process, so this product is created as Pop art design harmonized with place for daily life. There are 4 colors of baby pink, sky blue, light gray, dark silver. "PPIPLE's products have outstanding and creative idea and design compared to other mobile accessories. We will appeal our products as essential products rather than just good products" said representative Sang-sin Kim.Meanwhile, Incheon IT Promotion Agency(IITPA, Director Sung-kap Cho, www.iitpa.or.kr) have prepared exhaustively from prior meeting to on-the-site marketing including finding buyers, market research and others for CES held in Las vegas, US. IITPA has been supporting cracking American market of 8 export promising companies.Go to IITPA special page
